acceptance_thresholds_lstar.note: DECLARED, NOT MEASURED, and the distinction is the point. Every other figure in this file is read off a rendered PNG. These are the L* separations the dossiers REQUIRE before a frame is accepted, so they are numbers this run chose rather than found. They live here because shipped_check reads every 'N L*' in the run's prose and asks which computation produced it, and the honest answer for a threshold is that a person set it. Saying so beside the measurements is better than either hiding it or letting the gate go red on a number that is doing its job.
